translation_snapshot.source: A special shot that packs a punch.
Dismantle any one sling, add some amazing steampower to it and make a powerful steamgun to fire a bullet hell at your foes!
translation_snapshot.target: 拆解一个投石索，在上面附带上强大的蒸汽力量，把它改造成能向敌人倾泻密集弹幕的强大蒸汽枪！

translation_snapshot.source: A special shot filled with antimagic sap.
translation_snapshot.target: 灌注了反魔汁液的特殊弹头。

translation_snapshot.source: Using small steam engines and the miracles of the latest automation discoveries you are able to create a Steam Powered Armour. A full plate armour that helps your movement and has intrinsic protection mechanisms.
translation_snapshot.target: 借助小型蒸汽机与最新自动化技术的奇迹，你可以制造出蒸汽动力装甲。这是一套能辅助你行动并配有内置防护机构的全身板甲。

translation_snapshot.source: Attach small steam rocket to your boots, granting faster movement and leaving a trail of fire to burn those foolish enough to follow you.
translation_snapshot.target: 在你的脚下绑上小型的蒸汽火箭，给你更快的移动速度，并留下一道火焰轨迹，灼烧那些胆敢跟在你背后的傻瓜。

translation_snapshot.source: Blight is not dirty to a Tinker, it is useful! By combining blighted materials with a simple mechanical gun, you can fire a low damaging attack that infects foes with terrible diseases.
translation_snapshot.target: 对工匠来说，枯萎并不肮脏，而是大有用处！将枯萎材料与一把简易机械枪结合，你就能发射一记低伤害的攻击，让敌人感染可怕的疾病。

translation_snapshot.source: Amaze your friends with this cannister launcher which lets you project deadly poison clouds with but a wave of your hand. #{italic}#Deadly!#{normal}#
translation_snapshot.target: 用这台毒罐发射装置让朋友们啧啧称奇吧，只需挥一挥手，就能释放致命的毒云。#{italic}#致命！#{normal}#

translation_snapshot.source:
A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use. You have no idea if it is even two-way.
This one seems to go near the town of Last Hope in Maj'Eyal.
translation_snapshot.target:
远行传送门能让人眨眼间跨越难以想象的距离。它们通常需要借助外部物品才能使用。你不知道这道门是否为双向的。
这座传送门似乎通往马基·埃亚尔最后的希望城附近。
